sources.entry: Shiori - Simple bookmark manager built with Go. MIT Go/Docker

summary.one_liner: Shiori is a simple bookmark manager written in Go, usable as a command-line tool or web application and distributed as a single binary.
summary.what_it_does: Shiori manages bookmarks with add, edit, delete and search operations, available from a command-line interface or a web interface. It can import bookmarks from a Netscape Bookmark file and from Pocket, and export to Netscape Bookmark format. Where possible, it parses the readable content of a webpage and creates an offline archive of it. It supports sqlite3, PostgreSQL, MariaDB and MySQL as databases. A web extension for Firefox and Chrome is listed as beta. The README describes it as intended as a simple clone of Pocket.
use_cases: replace Pocket with a self-hosted alternative
import Pocket or Netscape bookmark files
archive offline copies of web pages
manage bookmarks from the command line
notable: Distributed as a single portable binary
Imports bookmarks from Pocket and Netscape Bookmark files
Creates offline archives of readable page content
caveats: Web extension support for Firefox and Chrome is marked BETA
Documentation is kept in a separate docs folder rather than the README
No install or run commands are given in the README
